title: Salesforce and Anthropic bring governed CRM work into Claude
friendlyTitle: Claude can now help sales teams work with Salesforce data
summary: Salesforce introduced Claudeforce, including a Salesforce-in-Claude plugin with 37 sales skills that can reason over Salesforce, Slack and connected email while applying existing permissions and business rules. It is in a customer pilot, with an open beta planned for September 2026.
friendlySummary: Salesforce and Anthropic made a Claude plugin with 37 sales skills. It can use company data from Salesforce and connected tools while following the company's access rules.
whyItMatters: This is a concrete shift from asking an assistant for advice to letting it prepare pipeline reviews, update records and run governed workflows inside a system of record. Sales teams should test the time savings alongside permission scope, data retention and approval rules before broad deployment.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Sales staff may spend less time searching through records and preparing reports. Companies should still check who can access data and which actions need approval.
